details:
Not even sure why this hasn't been tested or mentioned, but here are the bugs that I've noticed.

-Desktop Camera Controls get buggy when sitting down on a chair. First, if sitting down and hold down the mouse wheel for the first time, your head with shake left-right at supersonic speed. Once you let go of the wheel, it snaps your head straight forward and you become horizontally challanged until you stand or open-close the main menu (not to confused with the quick menu). When sitting down and trying to move camera, it will only be possible by pressing E/Q and if you try to move it by WASD, it will move your character, therefore standing you up.

-If you will have your Desktop Camera out while you are switching avatar, when you avatar switches, it will move the UI/Screen/Whatever you want to call, closer to your face. It will happen every time you switch while having the camera out and it only resets back when you rejoin the world/restart your game.

-Minor bug, but still is weird. If you are moving the camera, hold any direction keys and then let go of the mouse wheel without letting go of the directions keys (WASD), it will move you by an inch and if you move yourself (Holding right mouse button) and quickly switch to controlling the camera, when you will get back to controlling yourself, your legs will go in random places. Basically, IK bug.
title: Desktop Camera Bugs.
